title: Future Continuous and Future Perfect
ringkas: will be + V-ing, will have + V3, by + waktu
goals: membentuk **future continuous** dengan will be + V-ing
membentuk **future perfect** dengan will have + V3
memakai **by + waktu** dan **by the time** untuk future perfect
membedakan future simple, continuous, dan perfect

lesson.text: Dua tense masa depan yang lebih lanjut: **future continuous** (akan sedang berlangsung pada satu saat) dan **future perfect** (akan sudah selesai sebelum satu saat). Keduanya sangat berguna di kantor dan dalam rencana.

lesson.title: 1. Future continuous: will be + V-ing
table: [[At nine tomorrow, I will be working.]]

examples.en: [[This time next week, I'll be lying on a beach.]]
examples.id: Seminggu lagi pada jam ini, aku sedang berbaring di pantai.

examples.en: [[Don't call at seven. I'll be having dinner.]]
examples.id: Jangan menelepon pukul tujuh. Aku sedang makan malam.

examples.en: [[By the time you arrive, I will have cooked dinner.]]
examples.id: Pada saat kamu tiba, aku sudah memasak makan malam.

lesson.title: 3. Perbandingan tiga bentuk
table: [[At five, I will be finishing the report.]]
[[By five, I will have finished the report.]]

lesson.title: 4. Kata petunjuk
table: at + jam, this time tomorrow, all day
[[This time tomorrow, I will be flying.]]
by + waktu, by the time, before
[[By next year, I will have saved enough.]]

lesson.title: by dan until
lesson.text: Gunakan **by** untuk batas waktu penyelesaian: [[I will have finished by five.]] Gunakan **until** untuk kegiatan yang berlanjut sampai batas: [[I will be working until five.]]

Ms. Wong: Bisakah kita bertemu hari Jumat?
Sam: Pukul sembilan, saya akan sedang presentasi, jadi tidak bisa.
Ms. Wong: Bagaimana pukul sebelas?

read.text:
Ms. Wong: Can we meet on Friday?
Sam: At nine, I will be giving a presentation, so I can't.
Ms. Wong: What about eleven?
Sam: By eleven, I will have finished it. I will be free then.
Ms. Wong: Perfect. This time next week, we will be launching the new product.
Sam: By then, the team will have worked on it for six months.
